description: Base exception for stage-fatal acquisition failures: bulk-catalog fetch failure, missing required API key, or any condition that means the acquisition stage as a whole cannot produce a usable candidate set.
docstring:
Stage-fatal acquisition failure.

Raised for: a persistent bulk-catalog page failure (fetch_steamspy_catalog), a missing STEAM_WEB_API_KEY where a called endpoint requires one, or any other condition where continuing the stage would produce a meaningless partial result. NOT raised for an individual candidate's failed appdetails or review fetch -- those are recorded and counted (detail_failed / reviews_failed), never raised, per the module's core invariant that a per-app failure degrades that app, not the run.
postconditions: An AcquisitionError propagating out of run_acquisition results in the run's status being set to 'failed' with error_message populated from str(the exception), via orchestration's exception-to-terminal-status translation

edge_cases.input: STEAM_WEB_API_KEY is unset and a call requiring it is about to be made
edge_cases.expected_behavior: AcquisitionError raised before any request is issued, per the module's edge case 'Missing STEAM_WEB_API_KEY where required'

edge_cases.input: SteamSpy bulk endpoint is unreachable for the whole run (DNS failure on every page)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: AcquisitionError propagates out of fetch_steamspy_catalog / run_acquisition rather than yielding an empty candidate set silently

unit_tests.name: test_missing_api_key_raises_before_any_request
unit_tests.description: run_acquisition with settings.steam_web_api_key=None and a config that requires it raises AcquisitionError with zero HTTP calls made.

unit_tests.name: test_persistent_bulk_failure_raises
unit_tests.description: A stubbed transport failing every bulk-page request raises AcquisitionError.
